description: Scrape books, reviews, editions, quotes, authors, series, Listopia lists, shelves, genres, similar books, and release charts from Goodreads.

authorUrls.description: Goodreads author URLs or bare author IDs. (mode=authors, auto)
authorUrls.title: Author URLs or IDs

bookUrls.description: Goodreads book URLs, bare book IDs, or ISBNs. Used by books, reviews, editions, similar, and bookLists. (mode=books, reviews, editions, similar, bookLists, auto)
bookUrls.title: Book URLs or IDs

containsAuthor.description: Keep books with an author name containing this text.
containsAuthor.title: Contains author

containsGenre.description: Keep books with a genre containing this text.
containsGenre.title: Contains genre

detailLevel.description: Full returns complete book records. Listing returns lighter row records for search, author, series, list, shelf, and genre results.
detailLevel.title: Detail level

excludeSpoilers.description: Skip reviews Goodreads marks as containing spoilers. (mode=reviews)
excludeSpoilers.title: Exclude spoilers

genreNames.description: Genre slugs such as fantasy, romance, or science-fiction. (mode=genres, auto)
genreNames.title: Genre names

includeMetadata.description: Also emit one author, series, or Listopia summary record alongside the books.
includeMetadata.title: Include summary records

includeRelated.description: In auto mode, also collect reviews, editions, similar books, and lists for each book URL.
includeRelated.title: Include related book data

isbns.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 values. Hyphens and spaces are accepted. (mode=isbns, auto)
isbns.title: ISBNs

language.description: Keep books whose language starts with this text, for example en, English, or fre.
language.title: Language

listUrls.description: Listopia /list/show/ URLs or bare list IDs. (mode=lists, auto)
listUrls.title: Listopia URLs or IDs

maxEditionsPerBook.description: Editions to collect for each book. (mode=editions)
maxEditionsPerBook.title: Max editions per book

maxItems.description: Hard cap on every record emitted in the run, including review, edition, quote, list, and summary records.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxListsPerBook.description: Listopia lists to collect for each input book. (mode=bookLists)
maxListsPerBook.title: Max lists per book

maxQuotesPerSource.description: Quotes to collect from each tag, author, or work. (mode=quotes)
maxQuotesPerSource.title: Max quotes per source

maxReviewsPerBook.description: Reviews to collect for each book. (mode=reviews)
maxReviewsPerBook.title: Max reviews per book

maxSimilarPerBook.description: Similar books to collect for each input book. (mode=similar)
maxSimilarPerBook.title: Max similar books per book

minRating.description: Drop books rated below this value. Decimals such as 4.5 are supported.
minRating.title: Minimum average rating

minRatingsCount.description: Drop books with fewer ratings than this.
minRatingsCount.title: Minimum ratings count

mode.description: What to scrape. Auto runs every non-empty input you provide.
mode.title: Mode

publishYearMax.description: Drop books first published after this year.
publishYearMax.title: Published year to

publishYearMin.description: Drop books first published before this year.
publishYearMin.title: Published year from

quoteAuthorUrls.description: Author quote pages as Goodreads URLs or bare author IDs. (mode=quotes)
quoteAuthorUrls.title: Quote author URLs or IDs

quoteTags.description: Quote tag pages to scrape, such as love, life, or wisdom. (mode=quotes)
quoteTags.title: Quote tags

quoteWorkUrls.description: Work quote pages as Goodreads URLs or bare work IDs. (mode=quotes)
quoteWorkUrls.title: Quote work URLs or IDs

releaseMonth.description: Month of the new-releases chart, or all for the yearly chart. (mode=newReleases)
releaseMonth.title: Release chart month

reviewLanguage.description: Only collect reviews written in this language. (mode=reviews)
reviewLanguage.title: Review language

reviewRatingMax.description: Only collect reviews with at most this star rating. (mode=reviews)
reviewRatingMax.title: Maximum review rating

reviewRatingMin.description: Only collect reviews with at least this star rating. (mode=reviews)
reviewRatingMin.title: Minimum review rating

reviewSort.description: Order reviews by Goodreads default, newest first, or oldest first. (mode=reviews)
reviewSort.title: Review sort order

searchQueries.description: Titles, authors, or keywords to search for. (mode=search, auto)
searchQueries.title: Search queries

seriesUrls.description: Goodreads series URLs or bare series IDs. (mode=series, auto)
seriesUrls.title: Series URLs or IDs

shelfNames.description: Popular shelf names such as mystery, fantasy, or historical-fiction. (mode=shelves, auto)
shelfNames.title: Shelf names

title: Goodreads Scraper Input
